title: Re-cut the Head Swap and Draw It In tiles so the seam bisects the face
description: Both 4/5 flow tiles put their before/after seam beside the subject rather than through it, so neither reads as one character in two states. Re-cut both from the original plates: Head Swap's seam onto the sheriff's nose (plate x 857, t2i_008 -> flowHeadSwap_002), Draw It In's through the drawn woman's face (plate x 180, t2i_005 + the run-015 drawing -> flowScribObj_015). Stills only - no hero rebuild, no registry change.
